heading: Features
paragraphs: With bulk printing, you can now print multiple invoices, receipts, or any other sales documents all at once. This saves you time and effort compared to printing each document individually, making it a great option for businesses with high-volume sales or frequent invoicing needs.

The customer statement and balance feature allows users to view customer's account status including outstanding balances, recent payments, and overall financial standing with the company. It enables businesses to analyze their cash flow, manage receivables and minimize bad debts.
